title: Spatial inequities and livability in St. Louis — interactive companion
description:
Interactive companion to Favarão Leão et al., Exploring spatial inequities and livability: a mixed-methods study using artificial intelligence and community insights (Journal of Urban Health, 2026).

A vision–language model rated micro-scale built-environment features on 7,848 Google Street View street segments across the City of St. Louis. This repository contains the dashboard that presents those results alongside census-tract demographics, the build pipeline that regenerates every figure from the analysis sources, and the tract- and segment-level data.

Regression coefficients are recomputed from source rather than transcribed, so the slopes shown reproduce Figures 1 and 2 of the paper exactly.
